title: Accurate and efficient AI-assisted paradigm for adding granularity to ERA5 precipitation reanalysis.
summary: A neural network downscales ERA5 precipitation reanalysis to add spatial granularity and is compared against observed precipitation data.
ai_technology: The source reports cross-validation and precision-recall comparisons with logistic regression and other climate-data methods.
